She later built a life in Sydney with John Kolenda, whose career developed in mortgage broking and real estate. Her creative work includes interior design for a prominent Vaucluse residential project.

Milenka and John each held half of Daring Investments. Through that vehicle, she had relevant interests in Aura Group and associated funds, and later appeared among the Kolenda-associated parties in a listed financial-services transaction. Kolenda has also worked with Sydney-based Shadow Charters, adding marine hospitality to a career otherwise centred on jointly held investments and family assets.
